real_byte_checks.staging_boundary: The sidecar anchors identify previously published transport bytes; this review does not turn them into an independent historical audit or new qualification.

prior_full_scan.explanation: The implementer reported one completed stream scan of the 37 fixed Git parts, including SLIM_MANIFEST.json. This reviewer inspected the implementation and verified the resulting small fixed catalog bytes, and did not repeat that multi-gigabyte decompression.

reviewed_protocol.original_export_anchor: Both pack and verify require the caller-supplied SHA256 from the first original exporter. A hash asserted only inside the delta is insufficient.
reviewed_protocol.original_reader: The packer reuses the existing repack_winner9_private_evidence.Export.walk and its package/member hash and coverage checks.
reviewed_protocol.original_manifests: The original export manifest and every original package manifest remain embedded. EXPORT_METADATA.json must equal the original manifest with only files/packages removed; original acceptance metadata is not rewritten.
reviewed_protocol.member_partition: Each original package/member key belongs to exactly one of embedded, exact repository source reference, or prior archive member reference. Receiver checks preserve all original per-member metadata and reject overlaps, omissions and extra references.
reviewed_protocol.repository_sources: Only original verified project-source payloads can use this class. The receiver reads candidate blobs from the explicitly selected Git tree and checks exact SHA256 and length; working-tree drift does not supply bytes.
reviewed_protocol.prior_members: Only actual embedded regular members under the fixed old main archive's native-context prefix can supply prior references. The old slim source-reference table is not treated as an existing payload.
reviewed_protocol.streaming_receiver: GitParts checks each fixed part's order, length, SHA256 and Git blob identity. scan_prior streams and hashes every actual old member, compares the actual catalog/inventory, drains decompressed and compressed streams to EOF, then requires the full compressed size/hash. It does not unpack the multi-gigabyte donor to disk.
reviewed_protocol.supplemental_context: CurrentChen provenance uses an isolated supplemental namespace. Its text predicate and separate staging inventory cannot reclassify an original evidence member or change acceptance counts.
reviewed_protocol.publication: Outputs use temporary files and no-clobber publication. Successful receiver reports are written only after all checks, including a final delta-file identity check. CLI results are compact metadata.
reviewed_protocol.legacy_coverage_boundary: The unchanged original Winner9 coverage and full_p2_complete:false remain original metadata; they are not converted into a full-P2 completion claim.

fixed_external_artifacts.input_archive_boundary: The two already published input archives are checked as complete Git blobs by SHA256, byte length and Git blob identity. They are not new prior-member providers, and this tool does not claim a fresh per-member scan of those two archives.
